tasks.description: FMT_COMPILE 格式化 std::array 及输出到非 appender 迭代器时编译失败。修复范围、元组、映射所共用的输出上下文处理，保留普通格式化及宽度行为。
空文档以 parse_fragment 和 encoding_auto 加载时应成功并报告推断后的 UTF-8，而不是 encoding_auto。恢复空缓冲区的编码结果，保留显式编码及普通 XML 解析行为。
XMLDocument::DeleteNode(nullptr) 导致崩溃。空指针删除应安全且无副作用；保留真实子节点、根节点和未挂接节点的正常删除。
十六进制浮点零填充的位置错误。{:012a} 格式化 1.0 应得到 0x0000001p+0，零必须位于符号和 0x 前缀之后；保留自定义填充、普通浮点及负数行为。
复制含未赋值字符串变量的 xpath_variable_set 会触发断言。副本应包含变量且字符串值为空；保留赋值字符串、布尔值和数值变量的独立复制及赋值行为。

historical_qualification_scope: 10 dynamically qualified repository repair tasks; semantic issue scope is reported independently.

limitations: HOST_QUALIFIED is a native reference precheck, not isolated Docker qualification.
Final selection uses 37 fully audited continuation records and four explicit evidence/source-snapshot replays; initial, failed, cancelled and incomplete attempts remain separate.
No record of a prior repair-model attempt is not proof of unexposed model pretraining or strategy-development data.
All tasks underwent preparation/reference exposure; final holdout assignments and model/configuration budgets remain unfrozen.
The four replays use newer preparation code with Git deadlines and early build cleanup; every selected batch preserves its actual execution source snapshot.
host_requalification.bug_fix_duplicate_check: No two qualified bug_fix instances share both a base commit and any resolved issue number.
